scope: controlled reduced-round ChaCha bit-puncturing/trail-enumeration only; exact relative to the same bounded local sigma-cap family
transform: For each exact signed next-column marginal M_c(x0,x1,x2,x3), apply the same bounded inverse_qr_linear_hull operator linearly to every input mask tuple and signed-merge identical output tuples. This equals marginalize-after-global-column-propagation if the marginal representation/operator implementation is exact.

cap2_exact_validation.reference: explicit first-layer global hull, then apply the corresponding next-column inverse QR globally with beam=None/local_beam=None, then marginalize that column

cap3_measurement.backend: packed sparse signed merge; cache local inverse-QR hull by exact 4-word input mask tuple
measure: raw local trail outputs before signed merge

zero_marginal_rule: Columns whose exact signed input marginal is identically zero remain exactly zero under a linear QR transform. This does not imply zero joint cross-column correlation and must not be used to drop those variables in a future joint contraction.
next_only_if_pass: Freeze a pairwise/junction-tree cross-column contraction Stage2 that preserves joint correlations, validates cap2 against explicit two-column/global propagation, and counts factor generation + contraction + storage + later ranking/verification in TOTAL.
kill_rule: If cap2 transformed marginals fail exact support/coefficient/energy equality, or cap3 exact transformed marginals cannot all be completed under the frozen 2 GiB RSS / 1 GiB compact-representation budgets, close the exact single-column-transform route. Any approximation/top-K path requires a separate preregistered error-bounded plan.
forbidden: No beam/truncation for the exact gate, no cap/column threshold retuning after results, no treating zero marginals as absent joint correlations, no global cap3/cap4 second-layer Cartesian materialization, no hidden FWT preprocessing, no full ChaCha20 claim.
